feed.title: Indian Railways Expands Passenger Connectivity and Freight Capacity in August 2026; Freight Loading Grows by 5.4% Over August 2025
feed.summary: August 2026 witnessed significant expansion in railway connectivity and services across the country, with Indian Railways recording growth in both passenger movement and freight loading. During the month, 14 Amrit Bharat services were regularised, providing more affordable and comfortable travel options to passengers across several important routes, while 5 new Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals (GCTs) were commissioned to improve last-mile freight connectivity for industries. Indian Railways also recorded 5.4 per cent growth in freight loading, reflecting continued demand from key sectors of the economy. Passenger traffic increased as well, with additional special train services being operated to meet the surge in demand during the festival season. Indian Railways loaded 137.9 million tonnes of freight during August 2026, compared to 130.9 million tonnes in August 2025, registering a 5.4 per cent year-on-year growth.

feed.title: 50 Kilometres, Countless Beneficiaries: Mizoram’s Railway Lifeline Completes One Year of Success
feed.summary: On 13 th September 2025, the inauguration of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line and the Sairang Railway station by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, opened a new chapter of progress and development for Mizoram. Within just one year, the railway line has brought about transformative development in this remote hill state, and has transformed from just a line on the railway map into a gateway towards improved mobility, greater access to markets, enhanced tourism and new opportunities. For generations, Mizoram’s difficult terrain made long-distance movement heavily dependent on roads, making travel very time consuming, uncomfortable and unrealiable. The commissioning of the Bairabi-Sairang new railway line completed changed the scenario.

pib-2309663.title: Indian Railways Expands Passenger Connectivity and Freight Capacity in August 2026; Freight Loading Grows by 5.4% Over August 2025
pib-2309663.summary: August 2026 witnessed significant expansion in railway connectivity and services across the country, with Indian Railways recording growth in both passenger movement and freight loading. During the month, 14 Amrit Bharat services were regularised, providing more affordable and comfortable travel options to passengers across several important routes, while 5 new Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals (GCTs) were commissioned to improve last-mile freight connectivity for industries. Indian Railways also recorded 5.4 per cent growth in freight loading, reflecting continued demand from key sectors of the economy. Passenger traffic increased as well, with additional special train services being operated to meet the surge in demand during the festival season. Indian Railways loaded 137.9 million tonnes of freight during August 2026, compared to 130.9 million tonnes in August 2025, registering a 5.4 per cent year-on-year growth.

pib-2309650.title: 50 Kilometres, Countless Beneficiaries: Mizoram’s Railway Lifeline Completes One Year of Success
pib-2309650.summary: On 13 th September 2025, the inauguration of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line and the Sairang Railway station by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, opened a new chapter of progress and development for Mizoram. Within just one year, the railway line has brought about transformative development in this remote hill state, and has transformed from just a line on the railway map into a gateway towards improved mobility, greater access to markets, enhanced tourism and new opportunities. For generations, Mizoram’s difficult terrain made long-distance movement heavily dependent on roads, making travel very time consuming, uncomfortable and unrealiable. The commissioning of the Bairabi-Sairang new railway line completed changed the scenario.

pib-2309663.body:
{
  "itemId": "pib-2309663",
  "version": 3,
  "title": "Indian Railways Expands Passenger Connectivity and Freight Capacity in August 2026; Freight Loading Grows by 5.4% Over August 2025",
  "summary": "August 2026 witnessed significant expansion in railway connectivity and services across the country, with Indian Railways recording growth in both passenger movement and freight loading. During the month, 14 Amrit Bharat services were regularised, providing more affordable and comfortable travel options to passengers across several important routes, while 5 new Gati Shakti Cargo Terminals (GCTs) were commissioned to improve last-mile freight connectivity for industries. Indian Railways also recorded 5.4 per cent growth in freight loading, reflecting continued demand from key sectors of the economy. Passenger traffic increased as well, with additional special train services being operated to meet the surge in demand during the festival season. Indian Railways loaded 137.9 million tonnes of freight during August 2026, compared to 130.9 million tonnes in August 2025, registering a 5.4 per cent year-on-year growth.",

pib-2309650.body:
{
  "itemId": "pib-2309650",
  "version": 3,
  "title": "50 Kilometres, Countless Beneficiaries: Mizoram’s Railway Lifeline Completes One Year of Success",
  "summary": "On 13 th September 2025, the inauguration of the 51.38 km Bairabi-Sairang railway line and the Sairang Railway station by Hon’ble Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, opened a new chapter of progress and development for Mizoram. Within just one year, the railway line has brought about transformative development in this remote hill state, and has transformed from just a line on the railway map into a gateway towards improved mobility, greater access to markets, enhanced tourism and new opportunities. For generations, Mizoram’s difficult terrain made long-distance movement heavily dependent on roads, making travel very time consuming, uncomfortable and unrealiable. The commissioning of the Bairabi-Sairang new railway line completed changed the scenario.",

Within just one year, the railway line has brought about transformative development in this remote hill state, and has transformed from just a line on the railway map into a gateway towards improved mobility, greater access to markets, enhanced tourism and new opportunities. For generations, Mizoram’s difficult terrain made long-distance movement heavily dependent on roads, making travel very time consuming, uncomfortable and unrealiable. items.title: Spread the risk
items.prompt: What is diversification intended to do?

choices.text: Spread investments to help manage concentration risk
Guarantee that investments cannot lose value

source.title: Authored basic glossary · Diversification
source.excerpt: Diversification spreads investments across different exposures. It does not eliminate investment risk or guarantee a return.

items.title: Prices and purchasing power
items.prompt: If prices rise while your budget stays the same, what generally happens?

choices.text: The same budget automatically buys more
Every investment return rises by the same amount

source.title: Authored basic glossary · Inflation
source.excerpt: A rise in prices reduces what a fixed nominal budget can buy. A price index measures a defined basket, not every household’s exact experience.

items.title: When a published number changes
items.prompt: Why can a statistical agency revise an earlier GDP estimate?

choices.text: More complete source data or updated methods become available
To erase the need to keep the previous release
To guarantee the next quarter’s growth

source.title: Authored basic glossary · Data revisions
source.excerpt: Early estimates can be revised as source information improves. Compare the same period, unit and release edition; retain earlier editions for reconstruction.

items.title: Read a rate change
items.prompt: A change of 25 basis points equals how many percentage points?

source.title: Authored basic glossary · Basis points
source.excerpt: One basis point is one hundredth of a percentage point. Percentage-point changes and relative percentage changes are different measures.

items.title: Understand a trade balance
items.prompt: For a defined period and scope, what does a trade deficit mean?

choices.text: The value of imports exceeds the value of exports
Every listed company will lose money next quarter

source.title: Authored basic glossary · Trade balance
source.excerpt: A trade balance compares exports and imports for a stated period and coverage. The sign alone does not forecast any company’s earnings or investment returns.
